hero.motto: All your health data in your hands
hero.sub: Bringing medical experience to the 21st century

profiles.title: Family Health Hub
profiles.description: Manage health records for your entire family. Create individual profiles for each member — from children to elderly parents — and keep everything organized in one secure place.

import.title: Import Any Document
import.description: Upload lab results, prescriptions, discharge summaries, and imaging reports. Our AI automatically extracts structured data from PDFs, photos, and scanned documents — no manual entry needed.

signals.title: Health Signal Monitoring
signals.description: Track vital signs, lab values, and health metrics over time. Spot trends and anomalies with intelligent alerts that highlight what matters most for your health.

timeline.title: Your Health Timeline
timeline.description: See your complete medical history on a single timeline. Reference ranges, trends, and correlations between different health markers — all visualized for easy understanding.

weekly-plan.title: Weekly Health Plan
weekly-plan.description: Stay on top of medications, appointments, and health routines with a personalized weekly plan that adapts to your schedule and medical needs.

medications.title: Medication Management
medications.description: Keep track of all your medications, dosages, and schedules. Get reminders and see potential interactions — all automatically extracted from your medical documents.

imaging.title: Advanced Imaging
imaging.description: View and annotate medical imaging results with our interactive 3D body model. Map findings directly to anatomical structures for intuitive understanding.

ai-chat.title: AI Health Assistant
ai-chat.description: Ask questions about your health data and get intelligent answers grounded in your actual medical records. Our AI understands your complete health context.

security.title: Your Data, Your Control
security.description: End-to-end encryption ensures only you can access your health data. We use public-key cryptography so even our servers never see your unencrypted records.
